title: Quick Pro GR:ONE — DON'T Buy Until YOU Watch This (Chinese Aero Gravel Bike)

takeaways.text: Supplied by Quick Pro USA with an affiliate code. The presenter cites roughly 850–900 g for an XL frame in clear-coat raw carbon and about 930 g for a painted large; he did not show a weigh-in.
Threaded bottom bracket went in easily, brake mounts had no paint spill, UDH fitted, and a cover plate closes the front-derailleur mount on 1× builds.

The stock gravel seatpost has setback; the AR:ONE zero-offset post fits as an alternative. The matching gravel bar only goes to 100 mm stem length, so the 188 cm presenter chose the road Zephyr bar at 130 × 40 cm.
With the official 45 mm limit, he expects at most a tire measuring about 46 mm at the rear and wishes the next version took 50 mm.

disclosure: The creator uses a Quick Pro USA affiliate code.
summary: Overview of the GR:ONE frameset for prospective buyers: what is included, who it suits, sizing and the details to know before ordering.
